protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: wrapMetrics is installed as global middleware before routing and, from the root commit, passed attacker-controlled r.URL.Path into a Prometheus vector label. Distinct unmatched paths therefore create unbounded label cardinality and can exhaust memory; cbb7b65f4dd62b70d5f53c1d0ab4644bcedd1140 later added raw r.Method and more vectors but did not originate the already-sufficient path mechanism.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: CONFIRMED: 880365399bca9279049e7c77c554d26f2aaafa31 is the smallest surviving public commit in this repository that first writes wrapMetrics with path=r.URL.Path and defines the path-labeled MetricLatency vector.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: CONFIRMED: git rev-list --parents -n 1 returns only 880365399bca9279049e7c77c554d26f2aaafa31; the clone is not shallow and has no replace refs, so the commit is genuinely parentless rather than missing history.
protocol_checks.squash_member_decomposition: CONFIRMED: the BIC is the repository root initial import, not a later squash with recoverable public members. Its message says code was copied from Rekor, but this clone exposes no parent or finer public member to decompose; cbb7b65f4dd62b70d5f53c1d0ab4644bcedd1140 is a later expansion of the same mechanism.
protocol_checks.affected_release_membership: CONFIRMED: BIC 880365399bca9279049e7c77c554d26f2aaafa31 is an ancestor of v0.1.0, v1.2.9, and v2.0.6. Both v1.2.9 and v2.0.6 still pass raw r.URL.Path and r.Method into metric labels.
protocol_checks.fixed_release_membership: CONFIRMED: fix 506ec57b6ac2ea1e4739322e47453469425b69b5 is absent from v1.2.9 and v2.0.6 and is an ancestor of v2.1.0 (58ae149676e193d2dd7e7ee53f231b83fdd10fad). No v2.0.7 tag exists. CVE-2026-49835 is PUBLISHED and identifies versions before 2.1.0 as affected.
protocol_checks.direct_fix_or_verified_unpatched_state: CONFIRMED: 506ec57b6ac2ea1e4739322e47453469425b69b5 directly replaces raw path and method label values with strict path/method allowlists and a shared unrecognized bucket; its immediate parent ee10addd351dc6ee98cce8ff8fd371d7c46da954 retains the vulnerable raw values.
protocol_checks.bic_only_ai_attribution: CONFIRMED: the BIC commit object names Hayden Blauzvern <hblauzvern@google.com> as both author and committer and contains only a matching Signed-off-by trailer plus a GPG signature. It contains no AI coauthor, generator, bot, Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, or comparable marker; AI attribution was not inferred from later commits.

findings: The primary record correctly identifies the real CWE-770 mechanism and the parentless root commit 880365399bca9279049e7c77c554d26f2aaafa31 as the atomic BIC.
The primary record correctly treats cbb7b65f4dd62b70d5f53c1d0ab4644bcedd1140 as a same-mechanism expansion, not the introducer.
The direct fix and release boundary are independently reproduced: 506ec57b6ac2ea1e4739322e47453469425b69b5 lands in v2.1.0 and not v1.2.9 or v2.0.6.
